name: @corgelabs/corge
description: Corge: High-load serverless AI, durable workflow, payments & auth SDK for GCP Cloud Functions v2

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/corge.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/bin/corge.js && chmod +x dist/bin/corge.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run build
